basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Investor & AI Engineer | 18% CAGR (USD) over 13 Years, India-focused EM | Building AI Agents for Bottom-up Equity Research
basics.summary: 13+ years as a personal investor with an 18% CAGR (USD) track record, built on disciplined bottom-up, hypothesis-driven analysis with a major focus on India and adjacent Asian EMs. Indian-origin, on-the-ground fluency with Indian consumer, financial and IT names, regulation (SEBI, DTAA, FEMA) and the local sell side; extended into broader EM and DM through the same quality-at-a-reasonable-price lens. In parallel, Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building production multi-agent systems on GCP, and founder of PulseView, an AI market intelligence platform where agents generate and justify trading signals from technical and news data. I want to join Vontobel to combine deep India / EM conviction with an AI edge: agents that accelerate research, keep the mtx team's library alive, and surface mispriced EM quality stocks faster than the sell side.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Architected AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ signal sources (CRM, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory with per-agent read/write contracts and a freshness layer. Direct analog to a live research library where every fact is time-stamped, sourced and queryable.

Designed and shipped production multi-agent workflows (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK on Vertex AI) that 2x conversions and forecast $1M/quarter revenue. Same building blocks would let a research team automate deep-dive prep, industry mapping and sell-side digestion.
Run the full delivery loop: hypothesis, PoC, evaluations, tracing, cost-per-request telemetry, on-call. Disciplined, deadline-driven; reports directly to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected the Employee Referral System end-to-end. Understood the underlying unit economics and shipped the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA. Same commercial-first thinking I use when I underwrite a stock.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Rigorous cost analysis, ruthless prioritization, measurable payback.

Built GenAI demo system for sales that auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data. Cross-functional work with Product, Sales and CIO on GTM launches instrumented to prove impact within a week.

Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams: redesigned indexing and ranking to surface what users actually mean. Same discipline applied to distilling large, noisy information sets for decision-making.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production. Direct exposure to buy-side execution constraints, alpha decay and infrastructure trade-offs.

Technology evaluation panelist for 20+ fintech and AI startups. Assessed business models, moats, scalability and ESG readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions. Fundamental due diligence at seed stage.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer at an EPFL spin-off. Owned the commercial platform end-to-end that ran 500+ real-world deliveries and enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.
Built the business case, the tech and the customer conversations in parallel. Bottom-up understanding of an emerging industry from first principles.

projects.name: Personal Investing Track Record - 18% CAGR (USD), 13 Years, India-focused EM
projects.description: Managed my own portfolio for 13+ years using a bottom-up, quality-at-a-reasonable-price approach. Primary focus on Indian equities (consumer, financials, IT services, capital goods) with satellite positions across broader EM, US and EU. 18% CAGR in USD terms, benchmark-beating through multiple cycles including demonetisation, GST rollout, IL&FS and COVID drawdowns. Every position underwritten with a written thesis on business model, moat, unit economics, capital allocation and ESG / governance risk, with pre-defined invalidation triggers and position sizing rules.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: AI-native equity research platform. Agents ingest technical and news data, form a hypothesis, and generate AND justify a signal with cited evidence: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. Explainability, evaluation and back-testing built in. Built for my own portfolio first, now serving live retail users. Direct working analog of what an AI-augmented research desk could look like.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native platform for Swiss-Indian cross-border tax and regulatory compliance (India DTAA, FEMA, Swiss tax, SEBI on foreign investing). RAG-grounded assistant answers regulatory questions with citations back to the source; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users act. Kept me current on Indian tax, regulatory and capital-control regimes that directly shape investable Indian names. Same discipline (regulation-first, cite the source, guardrails before features) I would apply to ESG and country-risk screens on EM. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.
